Contract ManageBookCopyCRUDService::addBookCopy(callNo: String,barcode: String,location: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		book: Book = Book.allInstance()->any(b|b.CallNo = callNo),
		bookCopy: BookCopy = null
	precondition:
		Book.allInstance()->includes(book) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->excludes(bookCopy)
	postcondition:
		let bookCopy: BookCopy in
		bookCopy.oclIsNew() and
		bookCopy.Barcode = barcode and
		bookCopy.Location = location and
		bookCopy.Status = BookCopy::AVAILABLE and
		bookCopy.BookBelongs = book and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(bookCopy) and
		book.Copys->includes(bookCopy) and
		result = true
}
